performance.verdict: 9 milestones overdue; $142.84 spent with zero leads — infrastructure not live.

findings.text: 5 of 9 SOW milestones due 2026-07-31 are overdue: stack test, Como→GHL migration, GBP triage, Meta account/CAPI, and landing pages — all unconfirmed complete.
4 additional SOW milestones due Aug–Sep 1 are overdue: Meta reactivation lanes, Search campaigns, LSA submission, and nurture sequences — none marked live.
294 Meta clicks and $142.84 spend over 28 days produced 0 leads and 0 GA4 conversions — CPL is undefined; full funnel conversion is broken at or before the form.
GBP actions fell to 0 for 3 consecutive days (Sep 11–13) after averaging ~2–4/day earlier in the window — offline intent stalling as paid spend scales.
GA4 sessions dropped from a 3-day avg of ~155 (Sep 10–12) to 71 and 67 on Sep 12–13, a 57% 3-day decline — site traffic decelerating sharply.

suggestions.text: Pause WARM-RETARGETING Meta spend ($59.01 top campaign) until landing page and form conversion are confirmed tracking and converting.
suggestions.monday_update: Pause the WARM-RETARGETING campaign and all active Meta spend immediately. $142.84 has been spent over 28 days producing 0 leads and 0 GA4 conversions, confirming a broken funnel — not an ads problem. Success check: landing page loads, form submits, lead appears in GHL (or interim system), and GA4 records a conversion event. Re-evaluate spend resumption by 2026-09-21.

suggestions.text: Complete overdue end-to-end stack test: one touch → tracked → GHL → reporting; all 9 milestones are 14–46 days past due.
suggestions.monday_update: Run the end-to-end stack test that was due 2026-07-31 per Nacer's milestone. A test lead must travel from ad click → landing page form → GHL (or active CRM) → appear in reporting with a timestamp. This unblocks all 4 execution departments. Confirm completion and share the test record with Sohib by 2026-09-21.
